attr.title: Need for Speed: Underground 2
attr.desc: Native static binary recompilation of Need for Speed: Underground 2 (SPEED2.EXE) for Rockchip RK3326 and ARM64 Linux handhelds.
attr.inst: Copy your retail PC Need for Speed Underground 2 installation files into the ports/nfsu2/gamedata/ folder on your SD card. Required: SPEED2.EXE, GLOBAL, CARS, TRACKS, SOUND, MOVIES.
